rows.ja: 提携(相手側の年次報告に記載)
競合(相手側の年次報告に記載)

relations.text: Salesforceは未上場のAnthropic PBCへの出資を保有し、その帳簿価額は2026年7月31日時点で戦略投資ポートフォリオの約45%
relations.text_en: Salesforce holds a privately held investment in Anthropic PBC, carrying value about 45 percent of its strategic investments portfolio at July 31, 2026

source.label: Salesforce 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: the Company’s privately held investment in Anthropic PBC (“Anthropic”) had a carrying value that represented approximately 45 percent
source.note: Anthropicは未上場です。

relations.text: 2025年10月14日、提携を拡大し、ClaudeをAgentforce 360 Platformの基盤モデルの1つとした
relations.text_en: On October 14, 2025, the partnership was expanded, making Claude a foundational model for the Agentforce 360 Platform

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: Anthropic’s Claude, one of the world’s most powerful families of AI models, is a foundational model for Salesforce’s Agentforce 360 Platform
source.note: Anthropicは未上場です。

relations.text: Anthropic自身がSlackなどを使うSalesforceの顧客でもある
relations.text_en: Anthropic is itself a Salesforce customer, using Slack and Agentforce Sales

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: This partnership builds on Anthropic’s own success as a Salesforce customer using Slack and the Agentforce 360 Platform
source.note: Salesforceのプレスリリースに基づく顧客関係です。
source.note_en: Customer relationship per a Salesforce press release.

relations.text: SalesforceがClaude Codeを全世界のエンジニアリング組織に展開
relations.text_en: Salesforce is deploying Claude Code across its global engineering organization

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: Salesforce is deploying Claude Code across its global engineering organization
source.note: Anthropicは未上場です。

relations.text: OpenAIとの戦略的提携を拡大し、OpenAIのモデルをAgentforce 360で利用でき、SalesforceのアプリをChatGPTから使えるようにした
relations.text_en: Announced an expanded strategic partnership with OpenAI; OpenAI models are available in Agentforce 360 and Salesforce apps are accessible in ChatGPT

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) and OpenAI today announced an expanded strategic partnership
source.note: OpenAIは未上場です。

relations.text: OpenAIをAgentforce 360の推奨モデルの1つとし、Atlas Reasoning EngineとPrompt Builderの既定LLMに選べる
relations.text_en: OpenAI is featured as a preferred model provider in Agentforce 360, and customers can select it as the default LLM for the Atlas Reasoning Engine and Prompt Builder

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: OpenAI will also be featured as a preferred model, giving Agentforce 360 customers the option to select it as their default LLM for the Atlas Reasoning Engine and Prompt Builder
source.note: OpenAIは未上場です。

relations.text: OpenAIと新たなMissionforce提携を発表し、モデルを安全な政府向け環境に提供
relations.text_en: Announced a new Missionforce partnership with OpenAI to bring its models to secure government environments

source.label: Salesforce ニュースルーム
source.quote: Salesforce also announced a new Missionforce partnership with OpenAI to bring its leading AI models to secure government environments
source.note: Missionforce・政府向けクラウドの範囲で、一部は計画段階です。
source.note_en: Limited to Missionforce/Government Cloud; partly planned.

relations.text: AnthropicのAmazon Bedrock上のモデルをSalesforceのバーチャルプライベートクラウド内でAgentforce 360 Platformに提供
relations.text_en: Anthropic’s Amazon Bedrock-hosted models are offered within the Agentforce 360 Platform, contained in the Salesforce virtual private cloud

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: By offering Anthropic’s Amazon Bedrock-hosted models within the Agentforce 360 Platform
source.note: BedrockでのモデルのホスティングをSalesforceが発表したものです。
source.note_en: Model hosting via Bedrock, per a Salesforce press release.

relations.text: AWSとの戦略的提携を拡大。全Salesforceクラウドを23か国のAWS Marketplaceで提供し、Data CloudはAmazon RedshiftおよびBedrockと連携
relations.text_en: Expanded strategic partnership with AWS; all Salesforce clouds are available on AWS Marketplace in 23 countries and Data Cloud integrates with Amazon Redshift and Bedrock

source.label: Salesforce ニュースルーム
source.quote: All Salesforce clouds are available on AWS Marketplace in 23 countries
source.note: AWSはAmazonの事業部門です。2024年11月の記事に基づきます。
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com. Based on a November 2024 newsroom story.

relations.text: Googleと戦略的提携を拡大し、GeminiモデルをAgentforce 360 Platformに提供しGoogle Workspaceと連携
relations.text_en: Expanded the strategic partnership with Google, bringing Gemini models to the Agentforce 360 Platform and integrating with Google Workspace

source.label: Google Cloud の発表
source.quote: Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) and Google today announced an expansion of their strategic partnership

relations.text: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 NanoをAgentforceで利用でき、NVIDIAのAI基盤を使った参照アーキテクチャを共同開発
relations.text_en: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano is available within Agentforce; the companies are developing reference architectures using NVIDIA AI infrastructure

source.label: Salesforce ニュースルーム
source.quote: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano is available within Agentforce

relations.text: NVIDIAのAIプラットフォームとSalesforce Platform・Agentforceを組み合わせる戦略的協業を発表
relations.text_en: Announced a strategic collaboration combining the NVIDIA AI platform with the Salesforce Platform and Agentforce

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: Salesforce [NYSE: CRM] and NVIDIA today announced a strategic collaboration
source.note: 2024年9月の発表で、その後2026年に拡大されています。

companies.name: CrowdStrike
companies.sub: サイバーセキュリティ

relations.text: CrowdStrikeがAgentforceでAmazon Bedrock経由のClaudeを利用
relations.text_en: CrowdStrike uses Claude via Amazon Bedrock in Agentforce

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: CrowdStrike and RBC Wealth Management are using Claude via Amazon Bedrock in Agentforce
source.note: SalesforceとAnthropicの発表で顧客として挙げられています。
source.note_en: Named as a customer in the Salesforce/Anthropic press release.

relations.text: RBC Wealth ManagementがAgentforceでAmazon Bedrock経由のClaudeをアドバイザーの面談準備に利用
relations.text_en: RBC Wealth Management uses Claude via Amazon Bedrock in Agentforce for advisor meeting prep

source.label: Salesforce の発表
source.quote: CrowdStrike and RBC Wealth Management are using Claude via Amazon Bedrock in Agentforce
source.note: 子会社(RBC Wealth Management)の事例で、上場親会社はRoyal Bank of Canadaです。
source.note_en: Subsidiary-level (RBC Wealth Management); the listed parent is Royal Bank of Canada.

relations.text: Five9が年次報告で、パートナー網に含まれる主要CRMソフト企業の1社としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: Five9’s FY2025 10-K lists Salesforce among leading CRM software vendors in its partner ecosystem

source.label: Five9 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have built a robust ecosystem of partners including a variety of leading CRM software vendors such as Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Zendesk
source.note: 相手側の年次報告に基づくパートナー・連携関係です。

relations.text: DocuSignが年次報告で、Salesforceとの提携(製品連携と共同販売)を挙げている
relations.text_en: DocuSign’s FY2026 10-K cites a partnership with Salesforce, with product integrations and co-selling

source.label: DocuSign 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We have partnerships with some of the world’s foremost technology providers including Salesforce, Microsoft, SAP, Google, ServiceNow, and Workday
source.note: 相手側の年次報告に基づきます。

relations.text: Boxが年次報告で、連携しているパートナーの1社としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: Box’s FY2026 10-K lists Salesforce among partners it offers integrations with

source.label: Box 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: offering integrations with partners such as Adobe, Apple, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Google, Guidewire, IBM, Microsoft, Okta, Oracle-NetSuite, Palo Alto Networks, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Slack, USDM, Workday, and Zoom
source.note: 相手側の年次報告に基づく連携関係です。

relations.text: Zoomが年次報告で、Zoom Meetingsが連携するツールの提供元の1社としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: Zoom’s FY2026 10-K says Zoom Meetings integrates with tools created by companies such as Salesforce

source.label: Zoom 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Zoom Meetings integrates with tools created by companies such as Atlassian, Box, Dropbox, Google, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Slack
source.note: 相手側の年次報告に基づく連携関係です。

relations.text: Oktaが年次報告で、連携するアプリ・基盤提供企業の1社としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: Okta’s FY2026 10-K lists Salesforce among the applications and infrastructure providers it integrates with

source.label: Okta 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: including AWS, Atlassian, DocuSign, Google, Microsoft 365, NetSuite, Oracle, Palo Alto Networks, Proofpoint, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Slack, Splunk, VMware, Workday, Zendesk and Zoom
source.note: 相手側の年次報告に基づく連携関係です。

relations.text: Atlassianが年次報告で、自社アプリの相互運用先としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: Atlassian’s FY2026 10-K lists Salesforce among platforms its apps are kept interoperable with

source.label: Atlassian 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: such as Microsoft, Zoom, Anthropic, Cursor, OpenAI, Salesforce, Workday, and Dropbox
source.note: 相手側の年次報告に基づく相互運用です。

relations.text: Cognizantが年次報告で、技術パートナーとしてSalesforceと緊密に連携していると述べている
relations.text_en: Cognizant’s FY2025 10-K says it works closely with Salesforce as a technology partner

source.label: Cognizant 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We work closely with partners including Amazon Web Services, Cisco, Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Pegasystems, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Workday and many others
source.note: サービス提供側のパートナーとして相手側の年次報告に記載されています。

relations.text: Infosysが20年以上にわたるSalesforceの戦略的パートナーだと述べている
relations.text_en: Infosys describes itself as a strategic Salesforce partner for over two decades

source.label: Infosys 20-F(2026年度)
source.quote: Infosys ECAS Practice has been a strategic Salesforce partner for over two decades
source.note: サービス提供側のパートナーとして相手側の20-Fに記載されています。

relations.text: Wiproが年次報告で、戦略的な技術提携先の1社としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: Wipro’s FY2026 20-F lists Salesforce among its strategic technology partnerships

source.label: Wipro 20-F(2026年度)
source.quote: We have strategic partnerships with some of the world's most respected technology companies, such as AWS, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and SAP
source.note: サービス提供側のパートナーとして相手側の20-Fに記載されています。

relations.text: TTEC Digitalが、主要なCXソフト企業の1社としてSalesforceと戦略的提携を結んでいる
relations.text_en: TTEC Digital has strategic partnerships with leading CX software vendors including Salesforce

source.label: TTEC 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: TTEC Digital supports the majority of CX platform and solution requirements through its strategic partnerships with the leading CX software vendors including Genesys, Microsoft, Cisco, AWS, Google, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Nice among others
source.note: サービス提供側のパートナーとして相手側の年次報告に記載されています。

relations.text: IBMが年次報告で、ソフトウェア部門の主な競合の1社としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: IBM’s FY2025 10-K names Salesforce among the principal competitors in its software segment

source.label: IBM 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The principal competitors in this segment include: Alphabet (Google), Amazon, BMC, Broadcom, Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP and Splunk
source.note: IBMの年次報告に基づく競合の記載です。

relations.text: IBMが年次報告で、戦略的パートナーの1社としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: IBM’s FY2025 10-K lists Salesforce among its strategic partners

source.label: IBM 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our strategic partners include: Adobe, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft, Oracle, Palo Alto Networks, Salesforce, Samsung Electronics and SAP, among others
source.note: IBMは、パートナーが競合になる場合もあると記しています。
source.note_en: IBM notes partners may also be competitors.

relations.text: Freshworksが年次報告で、顧客体験製品の競合としてSalesforceを挙げている
relations.text_en: Freshworks’s FY2025 10-K names Salesforce as a competitor in customer experience products

source.label: Freshworks 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we primarily face competition from customer service suites such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom
